description: Operational scheduling config. Read by scripts/register_refresh_task.py and (optionally) by detection components that need office-hours awareness.

office_hours.notes: 24-hour HH:MM format. 'start' is used as the alignment anchor for the hourly threat-intel refresh task — the task runs every hour, 24/7, but its first scheduled run lands at this time. Edit this value then re-run scripts/register_refresh_task.py to apply.
